_note: Every asset each section expects. status: missing | placeholder | final. Dimensions in px (width x height). Rasters are generated from /art by `npm run images` at the widths in ASSETS.md; SVGs are copied. 'ratio' on a missing asset is the shape the layout will reserve for its labelled placeholder; confirm it with the illustrator.

how-it-works.name: howitworks-ceiling-diagram-wide
how-it-works.notes: Layered SVG. No text, numbers or arrows in the artwork: labels and numbered markers are HTML laid over it at 'anchors' (% of the viewBox; copy source: _data/how_it_works.json parts[]). Centre each named part on its anchor and keep a clear, low-detail zone of about 40px radius (viewBox units) around it, because a 28px marker sits on top. Must show: one system, only the active unit has the amplifier and Bluetooth, only the active unit is powered, ceiling socket not supplied.
